title: dendranthema lavandulifolium var. glabriusculum
intro: Dendranthema lavandulifolium var. glabriusculum, commonly known as Lavender Chrysanthemum, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including anxiety, insomnia, and skin conditions, due to its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Lavender Chrysanthemum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils that exhibit calming, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. Further research is needed to confirm the full range of bioactive constituents and their effects on human health.
